verdict.rationale: Replit documents a first-party Replit MCP Server that lets a compatible client create, find, inspect, or update Replit Apps (replit-docs-42). That gives AI-native users a documented programmatic surface, but it is narrow and MCP-based rather than a general public API. The probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path (replit-probe-2), and the evidence describes no REST endpoints, API keys, or reference docs. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose public REST/HTTP API, an API reference or OpenAPI spec, and documented auth for API access and coverage beyond app CRUD (e.g., deployments, agent tasks), plus independent hands-on corroboration.
